text: Third silence: First and second silence: repeat the question shorter. Third silence: say the silence sentence and end the call, no main menu.
Out-of-scope question: Ask whether the caller wants the main menu instead of sending them there directly; yes -> main menu, continue -> resume the flow, unclear -> three tries.
Angry caller: Up to three calming replies, then transfer to an agent; insults are never answered.
Two cards with the same last four digits: Ask the last six digits, and only if those match too, the card number.
Card number in speech: Never say more than the last four digits, whatever the service returns (masked in test, full in production).
Currency names: Always the full names Türk Lirası, Dolar, Euro, İngiliz Sterlini; the codes in the analysis sentences are replaced.
Statement week change limit: Once per calendar year; the limit sentence is optional; the monthly and three-per-year limits are not used.
E-mail address for the statement: Only the address registered at the bank; never an address the caller gives; only the latest statement.
Identity check: No second factor or any code is asked.
Payments and how to pay: No payment and no explanation of payment channels; transfer to an agent with the payment sentence.
Service failure versus no card: The card list 404 FB_IVR_CHANNEL_102 is the no-eligible-card case (main menu); any other service error or timeout goes to an agent, never the main menu.
Order after the reading: With more than one card the other-card question comes before the offer; the e-mail lookup runs before the offer.
Joint statement notice: The sentence that the other card is affected is said before the confirmation question.
Main menu sentences: Normal end: "Sizi ana menüye yönlendiriyorum."; three tries used up, no eligible card and non-Turkish use "aktarıyorum".
Earlier statement or other address requested: Say only the latest statement / only the registered address is possible and offer to send that; do not end the call at once.
Someone else's card: Say that for security reasons only the caller's own cards can be handled, give no information, and end with routing to the main menu.

No service tells whether the yearly statement week right is already used (contract 5.3, open point 3). The change is offered to everyone; a failing change goes to an agent with the statement week sentence.
Client timeout for a slow service is not agreed (contract section 7, analysis 11.2). 25 seconds is used because answers can take more than ten seconds and still succeed; no call is retried.
Which currencyType statement.pdf.send gets is not decided anywhere. The fixed value TL from the contract example is sent.
The request field call.ani (caller's number) has no call variable; it is sent empty. The contract says nothing depends on it.

The sentence for foreign currency debt moved into Turkish Lira (transferAmount above zero) was never drafted (analysis 11.4). A plain sentence naming the currency is said before the Turkish Lira figures.

No-statement-debt reading: whether the offer is made and whether foreign future totals are read is not agreed (analysis 4.7). No offer is made, only the Turkish Lira total is read, and a total that is zero or negative is left out.
How a card with no statement yet is recognised in the balance answer is not documented. A missing statementDate is treated as that case.
Cut-day and after-due-date readings have no fixed Turkish sentences beyond the cut-day example, and it is not said which totals are read. Only the Turkish Lira total debt is read.
When an e-mail address counts as long or messy is not defined (Selin was checking with Elçin). Addresses with digits, hyphens or more than one dot before the at sign are shortened.
For a third-party request the mails say back to the IVR login step, the example says main menu; no closing sentence is fixed. The ending wording is composed from Burcu's description.
Silence timing (seconds) was left for later; the platform default applies.
A customer whose only card has isMainCard false is treated as having no eligible card; the documents only describe the case where other cards exist.
Production cards.list returns full card numbers; with masked test data the last-six step often cannot separate two cards, so the agent goes on to the card number question.
contact.email.get failing after the balance succeeded: the documents only say agent. The debt is read first, then the caller is transferred.
